title: Concept: Backup copy of a page served by the app
description: A backup copy of a source file reachable under an editor suffix in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The backup holds the code as it was before a fix, so it can show the vulnerable line and the configuration the current file no longer carries.
applicability: Deployments that render a backup copy of a source file reachable under an editor suffix into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The backup holds the code as it was before a fix, so it can show the vulnerable line and the configuration the current file no longer carries.
